GH2 treatment of bovine submaxillary mucin O-glycans

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B.Rd

O-glycan-derived LC-MS profiles from bovine submaxillary mucin treated with six Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron GH2 enzymes. The experiment compares galactosidase activity on an intact complex mucin glycan substrate, including its sialylated and substituted forms. Supplementary Table S9B contains 56 features and seven observations.

Usage

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B

Format

A glyexp::GlycomicSE with 56 features and 7 observations. The abundance assay is in percentage of source total glycan AUC.

Source

GlycoPOST GPST000643. Supplementary Table S9B (media-10.xlsx). Study: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.26.714468. Repository: https://glycopost.glycosmos.org/entry/GPST000643.

Details

The seven source columns represent a control and separate treatments with BT1626, BT3179, BT3340, BT4050, BT4241 and BT4684. No replicate labels are supplied for these columns. This table concerns bovine submaxillary mucin without the sialidase/fucosidase pretreatment used in the separate S9C experiment.

Abundances are percentages of total source glycan AUC. Source galactose, sialylation, sulfate and fucose annotations accompany the molecular labels. A single column per condition should not be interpreted as replicated evidence for treatment effects.

Typed compositions cover the 56 features, with 40 encoded putative structures. Unresolved linkage descriptions remain in their original notation.

See also

glyhub_data_conventions for missing-value handling, annotations and access to original measurements and source coordinates.
